programmes.d: The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) bags Mexican-border silver smugglers for Uncle Sam.
A cavalry sergeant (Broderick Crawford) leads soldiers, civilians and an Indian (Johnny Stewart) on a desert trek.
A worthless gold mine leads the Durango Kid and a newspaperman on a trail marked by suspicion and deceit.
An Old West gunfighter (Hal Holbrook) turns a young farmer (Jeff Osterhage) into a justice fighter with a special gun.
Three trappers become scouts for a cavalry captain (Guy Madison) who loses his fort to a hated colonel (Robert Preston).
The new doctor (Robert Francis) at a cavalry fort finds resentment at first, even more once he treats Indians.
Farm boy Billy Bonney (Michael J. Pollard) rebels in 1870s Kansas and goes on to become Billy the Kid.
Two Confederates (Joe Namath, Jack Elam) save a man's (Woody Strode) life and cause trouble in 1865 Missouri.
After lying about being a stuntman, a blowhard (Buck Jones) gets the chance to prove himself to a movie studio.
Framed Texan (Robert Knapp) escapes for showdown with saloonkeeper (Walter Coy).
A woman and her two sons plot to drive other ranchers from their land after they discover a secret water source.
The Durango Kid learns that crooked scouts are behind attempts to escalate a war between a local tribe and the cavalry.
Settlers and a sheriff catch on to a Chicago swindler's land scam.
An Arizona land-grabber (Telly Savalas) and his brother (George Maharis) renew their feud amid Army troops and Apaches.
Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.
Two brothers (Kurt Russell, Tim Matheson), one raised by Indians, seek their sister in the 1890s West.
